Class CapabilityReport

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.capability.CapabilityReport
public final class CapabilityReport extends Object
Aggregated capability information from all discovered CapabilityProviders.

  • Method Details

    • environmentBySource

      public Map<String, List<String>> environmentBySource()
      Environment entries grouped by provider source.

      Each list entry is an environment variable name (value is resolved at print-time).

      Returns:
      unmodifiable map of source to environment variable names

    • propertiesBySource

      public Map<String, List<String>> propertiesBySource()
      Java/system properties (and similar) grouped by provider source.

      Each list entry is a property name (value is resolved at print-time).

      Returns:
      unmodifiable map of source to property names

    • featuresBySource

      public Map<String, Map<String,Object>> featuresBySource()
      Free-form capability/features map, grouped by provider source.

      Keys SHOULD use dotted notation to create stable namespaces, e.g. image.protocol.kitty.

      Returns:
      unmodifiable map of source to feature key-value pairs

    • feature

      public Optional<Object> feature(String source, String key)
      Looks up a feature value by source and key.
      Parameters:
      source - source id (e.g. tamboui-core)
      key - key within the source feature map
      Returns:
      the feature value if present

    • feature

      public <T> Optional<T> feature(String source, String key, Class<T> type)
      Looks up a feature by source and key, and returns it if it matches the requested type.
      Type Parameters:
      T - value type
      Parameters:
      source - source id (e.g. tamboui-core)
      key - key within the source feature map (prefer dotted notation)
      type - desired value type
      Returns:
      typed value if present and assignable to type

    • print

      Prints this capability report to the given stream.
